REQUEST: Ananya Iyer (SRE on-call), tenant acme, environment production, service checkout-api, as of 2026-09-22T10:30:00Z

CLAIM (procedure): Roll the release back through the release pipeline to the last good version.

QUOTES: E1: "Roll the release back through the release pipeline"

CITED EVIDENCE:
[E1] RB-CHK-007 v4 · Remediation · runbook of record · owner checkout-engineering · active since 2026-07-01
admissible for this request: yes
Roll the release back through the release pipeline (release-pipeline rollback checkout-api --to <previous-version>) to the last good version named in the deployment record. Do not restart pods or run kubectl rollout undo: a restart does not fix a regressed release, and the GitOps controller reverts direct changes.
